entries.target: A medium range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Manipulate the surrounding energies into your favor, and cripple your opponents. If you’re empowered by Chaos, consume it and create Disarray in your opponent, decreasing their damage dealt, Dodge, and Crit Chance by 20%. If you’re empowered by Unity, consume it and inflict Paresis upon your foe, increasing the damage they take by 20%. Both effects stack to 3 and last 20 seconds.
